editorial:
You are in for a breezy, feel-good romantic comedy about Jane, a woman who has been a bridesmaid 27 times but never the bride. She is kind, organized, and secretly in love with her boss, George. Things get messy when her younger sister Tess arrives, charms George, and quickly gets engaged to him. Jane is stuck planning the wedding while hiding her feelings. Along the way, she meets Kevin, a cynical wedding writer who sees through the fairy-tale stuff and challenges her to think about what she really wants. The movie has a light, playful vibe, with lots of wedding chaos, funny dress moments, and a slow-burn romance. It is not deep, but it is easy to watch and full of charm.

The best parts are the chemistry between Jane and Kevin, the big sister-little sister tension, and the colorful parade of bridesmaid dresses. Some jokes feel predictable, and a few characters are a bit too perfect or too selfish, but the pacing keeps things moving. If you want a cozy date-night movie or a fun group watch, this is a solid pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final stretch, Jane exposes Tess's lies about loving George's outdoorsy lifestyle during the rehearsal dinner, and George calls off the wedding. Jane and Tess eventually make peace, while Jane realizes Kevin is the one she truly loves. Kevin apologizes for his article and shows he cares, and the story ends with Jane finally stepping out of the bridesmaid role and getting her own happy ending with him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies and wedding chaos.
